# Build a Good Faith Estimate for a self-pay patient, and know when it is due.

> Free Good Faith Estimate generator for the No Surprises Act: list services with codes and charges, get a printable estimate, the delivery deadline, a completeness check, a $400 dispute check and a review of your past estimates. Runs in your browser; no patient data leaves it.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
